On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, which causes it to also gain 1 level of exhaustion. While affected in this way, the target must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. Three successful saves against the effect end it, and ending the effect removes any levels of exhaustion caused by it. Each failed save causes the target to suffer another level of exhaustion.
